description: Read a channel's public profile by username (the /@username page's data): metadata, owner display fields, follower count, live streams with playback endpoints, slots, and its public VODs and clips from Media. The owner and staff also see private listings; ingest keys are never returned. Anonymous callers are served (optionalAuth); no grant is checked at Live's boundary, and /api allows only OpenVibe origins for browsers. There is no public lookup by channel id yet (roadmap §30.2, sdk-live).
